title: ICAN Graro current official product page
notes: The current manufacturer storefront lists US$899 for a package including frame, fork, seatpost, bearings, thru axles, and derailleur hanger. It offers selectable 49/52/54/56/58 sizes and colors with free shipping; destination eligibility, taxes, and selected-option checkout remain unverified. The page also lists painted-frame weights of 1,073±20 g (glossy YS955 size 52), 1,095±20 g (glossy YS2386-1 size 52), and 1,130±20 g (Ice Crack Black & White size 54), plus a separate 470–525 g painted fork range.
